doc.title: Javon Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 3, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Students' worries and fall plans at Hartford
summary: Students reach out; the fall return is uncertain and faculty and administration do not know yet.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: Yeah. Let me return to the academic situation for a moment. I’m wondering if you’ve had an added role of trying to stay in touch with students and so forth, to just see how they’re doing and do you get a sense of how they’re being affected by this?

Sure. What happens too, a lot of students reach out, they’ll send a text, “Professor how are you?” I’ll get an email, thinking about you, and then obviously with the passing of some of the musicians I used to work with and had friendships with the students are aware of that so I get a lot of emails from them as well. It’s very interesting. They’re trying to figure this out, they’ll want to know what does their future look like for the fall for the university which we’re still in a holding pattern as this is taping in terms of how we’re going to go back. The plan is to go back, in person, at the beginning of school which would be late August, but that could change where it could be on another kind of an online kind of situation platform that could occur on some levels. As you know, some © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-

schools, like Notre Dame, are starting pretty quickly, as early as they can in August, to try to get it all in before Thanksgiving. So that’s what they’re trying anyway. So again I try to case-by-case students that are thinking about coming to the University of Hartford, Jackie McLean Institute of Jazz, they’re interested to know what’s going on and obviously all I can let them know is what I receive from the university because I don’t really know. But you’re right, there’s a lot of questions from faculty, from administration, and it’s a lot of not knowing.
